prompts.name: Decision Compass
prompts.layout:
Concept 01 / Decision Compass.
Change Section 2 domain to an INTERACTIVE STARTING-POINT EXPERIENCE, NOT a college list. Main copy at upper left on open ivory, line-break: "A clearer choice" / "starts with you." Supporting copy "Start with what matters to you. We’ll help you choose what to explore next."
Layout: a striking asymmetric editorial workspace. Left third contains headline, body, small prompt "Where are you in your journey?" and THREE elegant full-width selectable text rows separated by rules: "I know my course" with caption "Explore colleges for it"; "I’m choosing between courses" with caption "Compare study paths"; "I’m not sure yet" with caption "Explore interests and careers". Last row selected with a wine side stroke and pale taupe wash, no enclosing chunky cards. This is the interactive starting-point selection, not three ordinary icon cards.
Right two-thirds is an airy designed visual canvas: a large arch-cropped warm photograph of two Indian students discussing sketches, books and a laptop in a campus courtyard, placed toward far right; a second smaller portrait of a student thinking at a desk lies in a small offset rounded frame toward lower centre. Connect the images and THREE readable named decision stops using a single refined curved taupe route line across open space: "Your interests", "Possible courses", "College shortlist". Place the route on open background so it never covers faces or paragraphs. Small line-art book and campus gate at distant edge only. At mid-right under the photo, one slim warm-white contextual panel "Your next step" with "Explore interests and careers" and the burgundy CTA "Find my starting point →". Small secondary link "Browse colleges directly →" beneath the left selection rows. No mock career result, no fake matching percentages. Route is a light visual explanation, not a tangled radial diagram. The selected choice clearly corresponds to the CTA. Produce a memorable organised composition, artful curved masks and strong typography, while every item helps a confused student start.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate a premium creative professional desktop website SECTION TWO for NSEDU, the Indian student college and career exploration platform. Use the attached approved reference ONLY as a colour/typographic brand reference. This is a NEW secondary-section composition; do not reproduce the header, hero, student laptop group, old college directory cards, university fee cards, filter toolbar, or four-equal-card grids. The user rejected generic grids and dull blank backgrounds, and wants a substantially different content experience. Output a flat front-facing high-fidelity webpage screenshot, landscape 1672x941, not a browser/device mockup, slide or infographic. Only this one section in the frame; no full homepage.
Brand must continue primary wine #72243B, warm taupe #806C60, ivory #FFFAF8, pale greige #F1ECE8, dark text #2A2024. Wine is intentional emphasis and primary action; taupe is secondary accent. Natural photographic greens acceptable, NO blue/green/neon interface accents. Editorial DM Serif Display-like headings and Plus Jakarta Sans-like body/control text, careful typographic hierarchy. Heading approximately 44-52px on this wide canvas, body18-20px, readable labels16px. Curated art direction and purposeful asymmetric composition, strong aligned content, fluid rounded editorial photo masks and tasteful negative space. Background MUST look intentionally designed: ivory with one restrained large pale taupe architectural arch at the outer edge, extremely delicate campus line drawings or contour-line accents away from text, subtle warm light falloff. It remains LIGHT and readable. No flat empty screen, no full dark surface, no busy ornament, no giant flower patterns, no decorative explosions or overlapping content. No glass effects, dense dashboard widgets, fake AI scores, fake rankings or testimonial quotes.
Art direction: a professional contemporary editorial education experience, human and aspirational but practical. Warm natural-light candid photos of Indian university-age students; faces and hands anatomically believable, modern campus/study environment, varied student representation, no corporate suits. Use visuals to clarify the actual student task. No entire student-face wallpaper behind text. Deliver a sophisticated designed composition, not just text plus three boxes. Keep top/bottom breathing room around40px and meaningful information density. No huge empty canvas padding. Small corner identifier outside the product content: "NSEDU · Section 02" and the concept number/name. This is a static design proposal; do not imply tools already exist, actual numbers of users/colleges, verified facts, admissions guarantees or paid services. Provide a readable small bottom preview note "NSEDU design concept". Exact supplied English copy below, no lorem ipsum, no misspelt brand name.

prompts.name: Career Route Studio
prompts.layout:
Concept 02 / Career Route Studio.
Change domain to INTEREST → COURSE → CAREER EXPLORATION. Distinct composition: header left spanning only half the canvas, headline "Turn an interest" / "into a direction." Supporting sentence "Explore study paths and careers before choosing a college." A small quiet "Example pathway" tag makes this an illustrative guide, not a personal assessment.
Below header across almost full width a compact row of selectable interest chips: "Design & creativity" (wine selected), "Technology", "Business", "Healthcare", "Law & society". Keep all clear and finger-target-sized.
Main area is an OPEN horizontal pathway studio, not a table or college-card grid. Three aligned zones connected by a flowing taupe path behind the zones with labelled junctions "01 Interest", "02 Courses", "03 Careers". Left zone shows an elegant arched portrait of an Indian student sketching on a tablet with real sketchbook detail, caption "Design & creativity". Middle zone is a tall pale taupe editorial sheet headed "Study paths to explore", two neatly aligned rows "B.Des — Communication Design" and "B.Sc — Animation", each with simple course icon, quiet arrow and distinct spacing. Small explanatory line "Check each program’s eligibility." Right zone a white editorial panel with thin wine top rule headed "Careers to explore" and readable rows "UX designer", "Visual designer", "Animator" with understated fine line icons, no salary statistics or guaranteed degree-to-job mapping. A small "Paths vary by course and skills" note keeps it honest.
At lower right a primary wine CTA "Explore design colleges →", at lower left a slim text link "Not sure? Explore your interests →". The backdrop is a refined pale arch/ribbon with subtle sketchbook grid lines fading at one margin, huge restraint so text remains clean. Small photo insert of an actual design studio worktable at far right edge can enrich the pathway without any overlapping labels. Overall impression a professionally art-directed career exploration studio: helpful interactive pathway, not a kids' infographic, generic 3-step marketing banner or dashboard. Wide readable typography, creative connections and a clear next action.

prompts.name: Cost Clarity Desk
prompts.layout:
Concept 03 / Cost Clarity Desk.
Change domain to TOTAL STUDY-COST CLARITY, not tuition-only college discovery. Headline upper-left "Know the cost." / "Plan the whole picture." Supporting copy "Think beyond tuition—include accommodation and everyday essentials."
Composition has a generous left visual/editorial half and one polished interactive estimate sheet occupying the right half, offset slightly upward. Left includes a large warm arch-cropped student-life photo of Indian students beside a leafy campus residence, with an elegant foreground still-life of notebook, simple campus plan and pen in a smaller rounded photo crop. Two tiny connected annotation labels beside the image "Where you study" and "How you live", within open ivory space rather than opaque floating cards. A restrained sweeping taupe line flows from the campus photo to the estimate sheet, visually connecting campus choice and costs. Body content on left a tiny two-line educational caption "A course fee is only one part of your budget." and secondary link "Explore scholarship options →".
Right estimate sheet: warm white, refined double fine-line edge/soft shadow, radius18, title "Your annual study estimate", top toggle "Annual" active / "Monthly" inactive. Visible small tag "Illustrative inputs". Three editable rows with icon + label + editable rupee value: "Tuition" "₹1,80,000"; "Hostel & meals" "₹70,000"; "Books, travel & personal" "₹40,000". Subtle underlined inputs, no charts dashboard clutter. A single elegant segmented horizontal total-cost bar below uses wine for tuition, taupe for hostel, pale greige for essentials, in accurate proportions 180:70:40, no percentages needed. Then a clear total with label "Planning total / year" and value "₹2,90,000". Footer note inside sheet "Estimates vary by course, city and living arrangements." Main wine CTA "Build my study budget →". Lower edge note "Demo values—not college fee quotes."
Keep this a richly designed useful homepage teaser, not a banking app, bill receipt, cash/coin 3D render or a long calculator form. No loans, interest rates or financial recommendations. Light architectural curves and refined editorial photos make the background beautiful, the calculation remains readable and arithmetic correct. Strong distinction from prior college grids.

prompts.name: Campus Life Explorer
prompts.layout:
Concept 04 / Campus Life Explorer.
Change domain to CAMPUS FIT & STUDENT-LIFE EXPLORATION. Headline upper-left "Look beyond" / "the brochure." Supporting copy "Explore the spaces, support and everyday details that shape student life."
Composition is a rich, carefully gridded photo-story and topic guide. Left approximately60% holds a photo mosaic with ONE large landscape image of Indian students walking through a beautiful modern shaded college courtyard; beside it ONE slender portrait crop of a university library reading space; beneath the large image a smaller shallow strip showing students in a residence/common room. Rounded16/24px masks and one gentle arch only; no overlapping random collage. Small caption "Campus imagery is illustrative." Warm daylight palette, taupe architectural linework visible in outer margin and calm greige band behind the mosaic.
Right approximately40% presents a refined open editorial guide, not a set of chunky cards. At top three tabs "Living" wine active, "Learning", "Support". Below a small taupe eyebrow "CAMPUS ESSENTIALS", serif subheading "What to check before you choose". Three numbered expandable-looking rows with thin separators: "01 Hostel & meal costs" caption "What’s included, and what costs extra?"; "02 Getting around" caption "Commute, transport and access."; "03 Everyday support" caption "Health, wellbeing and student services." These are research questions, not confirmed amenities or safe-campus guarantees. Open the first row slightly to show "Compare room options, meal plans and additional charges." A slim topic icon and chevron per row only.
At bottom right the primary wine CTA "Explore campus essentials →"; a secondary small link "Find colleges in your preferred city →". Above mosaic a very small contextual pill "Make room for the everyday." This is a real usable editorial/student-life exploration section, not a college catalog, fake testimonial slider, news article grid or brochure advertising verified institution services. Eye-catching warm photography, elegant typography and subtle designed backdrop make it distinctive while the learning/living/support topic actions are obvious. No giant photographic wallpaper behind the text.
